name: Into The Bloodstream* (Ex)
body:
Benefit(s): The ninja is trained to deliver toxins into area’s of a target’s body that spreads them the most quickly. When the ninja makes a sneak attack with a poisoned weapon, she may sacrifice some of her sneak attack dice to increase the save DC of the poison used. The increase of the poison DC is based on how many sneak attack dice the ninja sacrifices as follows:

1 die = +1 to DC
2 dice = +2 to DC
4 dice = +3 to DC
8 dice = +4 to DC
